bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear and not exceed 12″ x 6″ x 12″, or be a non-clear small clutch not exceeding 4.5″ x 6.5″ x 2″. Diaper bags and medical equipment bags are allowed but subject to inspection.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″
Non-clear small clutches up to 4.5″ x 6.5″ x 2″
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical equipment bags are allowed but subject to inspection.

parking.note: Save Mart Center offers parking in the North lots and additional parking on Fresno State Campus. Standard vehicle parking is $30 for concerts and non-athletic events, while Fresno State men's basketball games charge $10. Parking fees are subject to change.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Save Mart Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Save Mart Center varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Save Mart Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Save Mart Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Save Mart Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Save Mart Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
